visualStyle: Monochrome historical photographic reconstruction with soft vintage optics, natural continuous tonal shading, gently faded silver-print feel, visible irregular grain and random noise, a few subtle dust specks and fine micro-scratches. No drawing, hatching or engraved paper. For dates before photography existed, this remains explicitly a fictional camera-style visualization, never an archival photo.
sceneBrief: 1840 Kim Jeong-hui departing Seoul for exile: rear view of a middle-aged Joseon scholar with a small bundle of books, escorted along an unpaved lane outside a modest tiled house, students bowing farewell. No exact face, no already-finished later artwork.

visualReview.notes: 직접 시각 검토: 추모·사찰 의식·2001년 유물 반환·2014년 전시·2009년 태극기 발견·민가 미사·유배길 장면 확인. EPY05 비문 및 EPY06 전시물 라벨, EPY08 신문은 재구성된 문자 유사무늬이며 원문 자료로 사용 불가. 의식·유물·복식 세부 고증은 미검증.
